	construction_time = slow_construction_time

	type_icon = "special_buildings/mines.dds"

	asset = {
		type = pdxmesh
		name = "building_special_mines_mesh"
	}

	can_construct_potential = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		building_requirement_tribal = no
	
            }
        }
    }

	can_construct = {

            AND = {
		building_requirement_castle_city_church = { LEVEL = 01 }
	
            }
        }
    }
	
	cost_gold = expensive_building_tier_3_cost

	province_modifier = {
		monthly_mining_tax = copper_mine_generic_building_tax_tier_1
		trade_good_copper_production_add = generic_copper_mine_tier_1_output
	}
	
	next_building = generic_copper_mines_02
	
	market_modifier = {
		trade_good_wood_sell_price_mult = special_building_need_sell_price
	}

	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		directive_to_build_economy_modifier = yes
		modifier = { # Fill all building slots before going for special buildings
			factor = 0
			free_building_slots > 0
		}
		ai_special_district_modifier = { LEVEL = 1 }
	}
	
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_wood
		amount = special_building_need_amount
		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 5

		modifiers = {
			county_modifier = {
				prosperity_growth_factor = special_building_need_prosperity_tiny
			}
		}
	}

	flag = special_mine_copper

		type = pdxmesh
		name = "building_special_mines_mesh"
	}

	can_construct_potential = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		building_requirement_tribal = no
	
            }
        }
    }

	can_construct = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		building_requirement_castle_city_church = { LEVEL = 01 }
	
            }
        }
    }
	
	cost_gold = expensive_building_tier_3_cost
	
	province_modifier = {
		monthly_mining_tax = silver_mine_building_tax_tier_1
		
	}
	county_modifier = {
		trade_good_silver_production_mult = special_mine_tier_1_mult
	}
	
	next_building = argentiera_mines_02
	
	market_modifier = {
		trade_good_wood_sell_price_mult = special_building_need_sell_price
	}

	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		directive_to_build_economy_modifier = yes
		modifier = { # Fill all building slots before going for special buildings
			factor = 0
			free_building_slots > 0
		}
		ai_special_district_modifier = { LEVEL = 1 }
	}
	
	
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_wood
		amount = special_building_need_amount
		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 5

		modifiers = {
			county_modifier = {
				prosperity_growth_factor = special_building_need_prosperity
			}
		}
	}

	flag = travel_point_of_interest_economic
	flag = special_mine
	flag = special_mine_silver
	flag = special_mine_copper
}

            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		holding_district_level_4_trigger = yes
	
            }
        }
    }
	can_construct = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		building_requirement_castle_city_church = { LEVEL = 04 }
		building_mineral_late_medieval_trigger = yes
	
            }
        }
    }
	
	cost_gold = expensive_building_tier_6_cost
	
	province_modifier = {
		monthly_mining_tax = silver_mine_building_tax_tier_4
		
	}
	county_modifier = {
		trade_good_gold_production_mult = special_mine_tier_4_mult
	}
	
	market_modifier = {
		trade_good_wood_sell_price_mult = special_building_need_sell_price
	}

	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		directive_to_build_economy_modifier = yes
		modifier = { # Fill all building slots before going for special buildings
			factor = 0
			free_building_slots > 0
		}
		ai_special_district_modifier = { LEVEL = 4 }
	}
	
	
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_wood
		amount = special_building_need_amount
		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 5

		modifiers = {
			county_modifier = {
				prosperity_growth_factor = special_building_need_prosperity_very_high
			}
		}
	}

	flag = travel_point_of_interest_economic
